Name: Cheaper Hay
Author: weissnicht01
Description:
Did you forget to cut enough grass for the winter? Are your animals starving? Do you think Marnie is illegaly extorting you? Then this mod is for you!

_____________

Reduces the price of hay at Marnie's Ranch. Hay now costs 10g.
This value can be changed in the config.
If you want to change it in-game, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]

_____________

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. Requires game version 1.6
